newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander sells Ebro stake to Gen Sucriere.
newsitem.headline: Santander sells Ebro stake to Gen Sucriere.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander has sold its 14.36 percent stake in sugar group Ebro Agricolas to Saint-Louis unit Generale Sucriere for 17.14 billion pesetas, local press reported on Tuesday.
Banco Santander was not available for comment.
Financial daily Negocios reported that the sale was effected on Friday, through various deals completed outside trading hours.
According to the reports, the Agriculture Ministry had received guarantees that Generale Sucriere would not interfere in the management after Ebro merged with Spain's largest sugar group Azucarera.
The upcoming merger, which will create the fifth largest sugar group in the European Union, was approved in December.
Generale Sucriere announced in December it intended to maintain or perhaps increase its 20.7 percent stake in Azucarera after the merger.
